column1: # Public pretrained weights that scripts/fetch_models.sh downloads (the Docker build runs it).
# Every file is pinned to an exact Hugging Face commit. Sizes and SHA-256 hashes are those of the exact files
# our submission was produced with (verified on 2026-09-26: they equal the Hub's LFS object ids, and the small
# files match the pinned commits' git blob ids).
# Columns (TAB-separated, no empty fields; '-' = no hash):
#   group  repo  revision  file_in_repo  path_under_HEARSAY_MODELS  bytes  sha256
# Groups: 'core' = needed to score (the fusion's detectors); 'la' = the official LA checkpoint, needed only
# by scripts that call hearsay.tak_aasist.load_la_model (fine-tuning, re-scoring); the inference pipeline
# builds tak_ft from the XLS-R config plus our own checkpoint (skip: --no-la / FETCH_LA=0); 'ecapa' =
# SpeechBrain speaker model for the speaker-consistency expert, report evidence only (--no-ecapa / FETCH_ECAPA=0).
